questions.prompt:
The number 2019 is the smallest positive integer that can be written in 6 ways as the sum of squares of 3 prime numbers. One such way is:

$$x^2 + x^2 + 41^2 = 2019$$

What is the value of $x$?

In physics, the kinetic energy $E$ of a particle with mass $m$ and momentum $p$ is described by the relation

$$E = \frac{p^2}{2m}.$$

What will happen to the kinetic energy of a particle if its mass is reduced to half of the original and its momentum is doubled?
Find the sum of the prime factors of $2^8 - 1$.
Consider all the integers from 1 to 100. Which of the following is NOT true about them?

choices.text: The number of even numbers is the same as the number of odd numbers.
Writing all the digits, the digit "0" is the least occurring digit.
There are more even numbers than prime numbers.
The number of multiples of 8 is the same as the number of multiples of 9.
The average of the 100 numbers is not an integer.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest four-digit number that is divisible by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10?

The number of Instagram followers of Ariana rose 10% from September to October, then dropped 20% from October to November, then rose 50% from November to December. What was the percentage increase from September to December?

In network science, a "fully connected network" is represented by a graph in such a way that each pair of vertices (called nodes) is connected by exactly one line segment (called a connection). For instance, a fully connected network with 5 nodes is illustrated in the picture. This network has 10 connections as shown. How many connections does a fully connected network with 10 nodes have?
The product of 46 integers is 1. Which of the following cannot be the sum of these 46 integers?
In the triangle below, $AB = BD = DE = EC$. Given $\angle ABE = 120^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BDA$?

The operator $\otimes$ acts on two numbers to give the following outcomes:

$$2\otimes 6 = 44,\quad 4\otimes 10 = 87,\quad 8\otimes 18 = 1613,\quad 16\otimes 22 = 2019.$$

What is the value of $32\otimes 34$?

In a camp, each student played at least 2 games. The games were Scavenger Hunt, Animal Charades and Musical Chairs. Twelve students played all three games, 33 played the Scavenger Hunt, 29 played the Animal Charades and 36 played the Musical Chairs. How many students were there in the camp?
Which cube below will be formed when the net in the picture is folded?

Find the numerator of the following sum in its simplest form.

$$\frac12+\frac34+\frac78+\cdots+\frac{511}{512}$$

A leader asked his 6 followers what is inside the gift box he saw. These 6 followers are sitting around a table. Two of them are truth-tellers and they are sitting next to each other. Two followers are liars and they are sitting next to each other as well. Each of the remaining two followers is either a truth-teller or liar, and they are not sitting next to each other. The responses of the followers are shown in the picture.

What is inside the gift box?

Two calendars are the same if all their dates correspond to the same days. The calendar for the year 2019 is the same for the year ____.

(Years 2016, 2012, 2008 and 2004 are leap years.)
How many triangles are there in the figure below?

The following bar chart shows the number of customers per day a shop had last week. The average number of customers in the first 4 days was 65% of the average number of customers in the last 3 days. How many customers did the shop have last Tuesday?

Annabelle, Betty, Cynthia and Dora were playing a new video game. After the first round of the game:

- Betty and Dora had the same number of gold coins.
- The number of Cynthia's gold coins was half the average number of gold coins that Annabelle and Betty had.
- Cynthia had 10 fewer gold coins than Dora.
- Annabelle's number of gold coins was half of Betty's.

What was their total number of gold coins after the first round?

What is the missing number in the sequence below?

$$311,\ 282,\ 313,\ 304,\ 315,\ 306,\ 317,\ ?,\ 309$$
Find the smallest positive integer $n$ for which $225n$ is a multiple of $4500$.
In the diagram, $ABCD$ and $DEFG$ are squares with $AB = 15$ cm and $DE = 11$ cm. If $\angle CDG = 90^\circ$, find the area (in $\text{cm}^2$) of the shaded quadrilateral.

How many 3-digit numbers have the following properties?

- The number is a multiple of 6.
- It remains a multiple of 6 when its tens and ones digits are switched.

Find the sum of the digits of the following product.

$$\underbrace{333\ldots3}_{100\text{ threes}}\times 2019$$

In the following cryptarithm, all the different letters stand for different digits. What is the value of the sum $R+E+D+A$?

$$\begin{array}{cccc} & R & E & D\\ +& D & E & E & R\\ \hline & R & D & R & A\end{array}$$
It is given that $159n+49$ is a four-digit perfect square, where $n$ is a positive integer. Find the value of $n$.
Three apples and four oranges cost $\$10.90$, while five apples and seven oranges cost $\$18.90$. How much do nine apples and 13 oranges cost?
In the diagram, $d_1$ is parallel to $d_2$ and $a+b+c+d=460^\circ$. What is angle $e$ in degrees?

Find the next term of the following sequence.

$$1935,\ 1940,\ 1948,\ 1962,\ 1985,\ 2020,\ \ldots$$

Find the last digit of the following product.

$$2^{2020}\times3^{2022}$$

In the rectangle $ABCD$, point $E$ is on the side $AB$ while point $F$ is on the side $AD$ such that $BE=\frac14AE$ and $DF=\frac23AD$. What is the ratio of the areas of the rectangle $ABCD$ to triangle $FEC$?
The six-digit number $2X475Y$ is divisible by 36. How many possible values of $X$ are there?

There are roses and lilies at a flower shop. Four roses cost $\$7$ while three lilies cost $\$8$. Billy bought some roses and lilies and paid $\$86$. Which of the following can be the number of roses he bought?
How many triples $(x,y,z)$ of positive integers are there such that $x+y+z=14$? Take note that $(x,y,z)$, $(x,z,y)$, $(y,z,x)$, $(y,x,z)$, $(z,x,y)$ and $(z,y,x)$ are the same triple.

What is the least number of weights required to weigh any object of an integer number of grams from 1 to 35 grams? The weights must be put on one plate while the object is put on the other plate. Also, the weights must be an integer number of grams.

Each face of a soccer ball is either a pentagon or a hexagon. Each pentagonal face is adjacent to five hexagonal faces and each hexagonal face is adjacent to three pentagonal and three hexagonal faces. If the ball has 12 pentagonal faces, how many hexagonal faces are there?

Alice, Jane, Philip and Victor were born in 1982, 1983, 1984, 1985 in the cities of Athens, Moscow, Paris and Singapore, though not in that order. It is given that

- The person born in Paris is one year older than the one born in Singapore.
- Victor was born one year later than the person born in Paris.
- Philip was born in Moscow.
- Alice was born two years later than Victor was.

Which year was Jane born in?
In the diagram, an ant can move only upwards or rightwards. How many ways are there for the ant to get from point $A$ to point $B$ along the existing lines?

Henry has a bag with 13 yellow, seven brown, 25 red and ten green balls. All the balls are of the same size and shape. What is the least number of balls Henry needs to take out without looking to make sure that he gets three different coloured balls?
How many four-digit numbers are there between 3700 and 9600 that can be formed using only the digits 3, 7, 5, 6, 0 or 9 without repetition of any digits?

The following bar chart shows the responses made by all Secondary 1 students from Integrity Secondary School in a multiple-choice question. All the horizontal lines are equally spaced. The correct answer scores 2 points, 0 points for no response and $-1$ point for the wrong answer. The total points scored by all the students is $-120$. If the correct answer is B, how many students solved the question correctly?

Andrea and Claire left from Woodlands and HarbourFront respectively and travelled towards each other at the same time. When Andrea arrived at HarbourFront, Claire needed to travel for another 5 km more to reach Woodlands. If Andrea travelled 20% faster than Claire, find the distance, in km, between Woodlands and HarbourFront.
Find the smallest positive integer $n$ for which $3993n$ is a multiple of $2475$.

In the diagram, four identical circles touch the large circle and pass through the centre of the large circle. If the diameter of the large circle is 28 cm, find the area (in $\text{cm}^2$) of the shaded region. (Use $\pi=\frac{22}{7}$.)

Denote $\{n\}=1+3+5+\cdots+(2n-1)$. For example, $\{5\}=1+3+5+7+9$. Given that

$$\frac{\{m\}}{m}+m=2020,$$

what is the value of $m$?
What is the smallest positive integer that has exactly 3 odd divisors and 3 even divisors?

The operator $\wedge$ acts on two integers to give the following outcomes:

$$4\wedge8=2412,\quad 5\wedge9=2812,\quad 1\wedge7=1618,\quad 2\wedge3=103.$$

What is the value of $6\wedge7$?

Peter has five different books of different subjects to be placed on a single-decked shelf. He does not want to place the Physics book next to the Biology one. In how many ways can he place all his books?

Peter and Frank together can build a house in 12 days. Frank and George together can build the same house in six days. It is given that each of them works exactly nine hours per day. If Peter and George together can build the house in 6.5 days, how long (in hours) will Peter, Frank and George work together to build the house? Round your answer to the nearest hour.

In the following cryptarithm, all the different letters stand for different digits.

$$\begin{array}{ccccc} & & W & I & N\\ +& S & A & S & M & O\\ \hline & M & E & D & A & L\end{array}$$

If $N=7$ and $M=6$, find the value of the sum $S+A+S+M+O$.
